models.name: shopping_mall_guests
models.description: Stores temporary anonymous guest accounts identified by a device fingerprint for unauthenticated browsing and limited participation where allowed. Each record represents a single guest identity used across requests until it is soft-deleted.

plainFields.name: fingerprint
plainFields.description: Stable device fingerprint used to identify the same anonymous guest across requests.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: When the guest identity was created.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: When the guest identity record was last updated.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: When the guest identity was soft-deleted.

models.name: shopping_mall_guest_sessions
models.description: Temporary guest session tokens used to keep anonymous visitors authenticated for guest-only browsing and guest access boundaries. Stores connection metadata (IP and referrer context) and session expiration to support secure session usage and auditability.

foreignFields.name: shopping_mall_guest_id
foreignFields.description: Belonged guest {@link shopping_mall_guests.id}.

plainFields.name: ip
plainFields.description: Client IP address captured at session establishment.

plainFields.name: href
plainFields.description: Request URL or origin link captured when the session was established.

plainFields.name: referrer
plainFields.description: HTTP referrer URL captured when the session was established.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Session creation timestamp.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Session last update timestamp.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Soft delete timestamp for session records.

plainFields.name: expired_at
plainFields.description: When the session expires and should be considered invalid.

models.name: shopping_mall_members
models.description: Registered member accounts for authenticated customer/seller access. This table stores the canonical login identity (email) and password credential hash for members; it is the parent for member sessions and account recovery flows handled by separate tables in the Actors component.

plainFields.name: email
plainFields.description: Unique email address used as the login identifier for member accounts.

plainFields.name: password_hash
plainFields.description: Hashed password credential for authenticating the member account.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: When this member account record was created.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: When this member account record was last updated.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Soft delete timestamp. When set, the member is treated as deleted/disabled while keeping historical records.

models.name: shopping_mall_member_sessions
models.description: JWT session tokens for authenticated member access. Each record stores connection metadata (IP and referring URLs) for auditing and security, and defines when the session expires.

foreignFields.name: shopping_mall_member_id
foreignFields.description: Belonged member's {@link shopping_mall_members.id}.

plainFields.name: ip
plainFields.description: IP address used when establishing the session.

plainFields.name: href
plainFields.description: The URL (href) that the client attempted to access when creating the session.

plainFields.name: referrer
plainFields.description: The HTTP referrer URL (if any) associated with the session creation request.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Session creation timestamp.

plainFields.name: expired_at
plainFields.description: Session expiration timestamp; after this time the session must be treated as invalid.

models.name: shopping_mall_member_password_resets
models.description: Stores password reset tokens issued to member accounts for account recovery. Each record ties a reset token to exactly one member and includes an expiration timestamp so the system can invalidate old tokens. Soft deletion is supported via deleted_at, and the token is typically one-time-use and becomes unusable after successful reset.

foreignFields.name: shopping_mall_member_id
foreignFields.description: Belonged member's {@link shopping_mall_members.id}.

plainFields.name: token
plainFields.description: Opaque reset token presented by the member to verify the password reset request.

plainFields.name: expires_at
plainFields.description: When this reset token becomes invalid.

plainFields.name: used_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the token was successfully used for resetting the password. Null means unused.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Record creation time.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Record last update time.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Soft delete timestamp. If set, this reset token record is treated as deleted/invalid.

models.name: shopping_mall_member_email_verifications
models.description:
Email verification tokens issued to members to confirm ownership of their registration email address.

This table stores token values along with expiration timestamps and belongs to {@link shopping_mall_members}. Verification logic should treat non-expired, non-deleted tokens as eligible; once used (by application logic), the token record may be soft-deleted to prevent reuse.

foreignFields.name: shopping_mall_member_id
foreignFields.description: Belonged member’s {@link shopping_mall_member_email_verifications.shopping_mall_member_id} points to {@link shopping_mall_members.id}.

plainFields.name: token
plainFields.description: Opaque email verification token value presented by the user to confirm email ownership.

plainFields.name: expires_at
plainFields.description: When this verification token becomes invalid.

plainFields.name: used_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when this token was successfully used for verification. Null means the token has not been used yet.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Record creation time.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Record last update time.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Soft delete timestamp to disable tokens after use or cancellation per retention policy.

models.name: shopping_mall_member_oauth_connections
models.description: Stores optional OAuth/OpenID Connect provider connections for a registered member account. Each connection links the member to a specific external identity using the provider identifier and the provider-side user id, enabling account linking during login.

foreignFields.name: shopping_mall_member_id
foreignFields.description: Belonged member connection owner {@link shopping_mall_members.id}.

plainFields.name: provider
plainFields.description: OAuth/OpenID Connect provider identifier (e.g., 'google', 'github').

plainFields.name: provider_user_id
plainFields.description: User id provided by the OAuth provider for this member connection (provider-scoped).

plainFields.name: display_name
plainFields.description: Display name retrieved from the OAuth provider at the time of linking (may change over time).

plainFields.name: email
plainFields.description: Email retrieved from the OAuth provider at the time of linking (may be null depending on provider/consent).

plainFields.name: profile_url
plainFields.description: Profile URL at the OAuth provider, if provided during linking.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Record creation timestamp.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Record last update timestamp.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Soft delete timestamp. Null means the connection is active.

models.name: shopping_mall_admins
models.description:
Administrator account records for platform governance and elevated access.

These accounts store the canonical administrator identity and authentication credentials (email and password hash). Administrator lifecycle operations (create, update profile/credentials, soft delete, and account access restrictions) are managed through this table, while login session tokens and password reset tokens are handled in dedicated child tables: {@link shopping_mall_admin_sessions} and {@link shopping_mall_admin_password_resets}.

plainFields.name: email
plainFields.description: Administrator login email address. Must be unique across all administrator accounts.

plainFields.name: password_hash
plainFields.description: BCrypt/argon2 (or equivalent) hash of the administrator password used for authentication.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the administrator account was created.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the administrator account was last updated.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Soft delete timestamp. When set, the administrator account is considered deleted/disabled.

models.name: shopping_mall_admin_sessions
models.description:
Stores JWT session tokens and connection context for administrator authentication.

Each record represents an active or historical login session for an {@link shopping_mall_admins.id} administrator account. The table is used to track session validity boundaries via expired_at and to retain connection context (ip, href, referrer) for auditing and troubleshooting.

foreignFields.name: shopping_mall_admin_id
foreignFields.description: Belonged administrator's {@link shopping_mall_admins.id}. (Session owner.)

plainFields.name: ip
plainFields.description: IP address used when establishing the session.

plainFields.name: href
plainFields.description: Requested URL (href) at the time the session was established.

plainFields.name: referrer
plainFields.description: Referrer URL (referrer) associated with the session establishment request.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Time when the session was created.

plainFields.name: expired_at
plainFields.description: Expiration time of the session. Sessions after this time should be treated as invalid.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Time when this record was last updated.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Soft delete timestamp. Null means the session record is not soft-deleted.

models.name: shopping_mall_admin_password_resets
models.description: Stores password reset tokens for administrator accounts, including the token value and its expiration time. This table supports secure account recovery by allowing administrators to request a reset and then redeem the token before it expires. Records may be soft-deleted after use or after cleanup without breaking referential integrity.

foreignFields.name: shopping_mall_admins_id
foreignFields.description: Belonged administrator account referenced by {@link shopping_mall_admins.id}.

plainFields.name: token
plainFields.description: Opaque reset token used to authenticate the password reset attempt.

plainFields.name: expires_at
plainFields.description: When this reset token becomes invalid. Token-based reset must be completed before this time.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Record creation timestamp.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Record last update timestamp.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Soft delete timestamp. Set when the token is revoked or removed from active use.

models.name: shopping_mall_snapshots
models.description: Generic immutable snapshot records for capturing point-in-time states of multiple editable domain concepts for audit and dispute resolution. Each snapshot stores the source discriminator and the minimal linkage keys back to the originating editable entity (e.g., product, product variant, order item, review, cancellation request, refund request), while the snapshot content is stored separately via other snapshot payload tables in the Systematic component.

plainFields.name: snapshot_code
plainFields.description: Human-readable identifier/code for the snapshot record for referencing in logs, UIs, and dispute resolution workflows.

plainFields.name: source_type
plainFields.description: Discriminator for which domain concept this snapshot represents (e.g., product, product_variant, order_item, review, cancellation_request, refund_request).

plainFields.name: source_entity_id
plainFields.description: The primary key of the source entity instance that this snapshot captures at creation time.

plainFields.name: source_seller_id
plainFields.description: Optional seller linkage for snapshots that are seller-contextual (e.g., order-item purchase context where the seller snapshot at purchase time is relevant).

plainFields.name: source_order_id
plainFields.description: Optional order linkage for snapshots related to order state (e.g., order item or associated disputes).

plainFields.name: source_order_item_id
plainFields.description: Optional order-item linkage for snapshots related to an individual purchased line item.

plainFields.name: source_review_id
plainFields.description: Optional review linkage for snapshots related to a review edit history.

plainFields.name: source_cancellation_request_id
plainFields.description: Optional cancellation request linkage for snapshots related to cancellation workflows.

plainFields.name: source_refund_request_id
plainFields.description: Optional refund request linkage for snapshots related to refund workflows.

plainFields.name: created_by_member_id
plainFields.description: Optional reference to the member that initiated the change captured by this snapshot (when applicable for dispute context).

plainFields.name: reason
plainFields.description: Business reason/category describing why this snapshot was created (e.g., edit, workflow transition, dispute creation).

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Snapshot creation timestamp. Used for historical ordering and dispute timelines.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Last update timestamp for the snapshot record metadata (payload/content tables are managed separately).

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Soft-delete timestamp for the snapshot record metadata, if the system needs to hide invalidated snapshots while preserving referential integrity.

models.name: shopping_mall_snapshot_parties
models.description: Junction table that defines which parties are allowed to view a given snapshot for dispute resolution. Each row represents one visibility relationship between a snapshot and a single party reference (e.g., an owner reference or an admin visibility entry).

foreignFields.name: shopping_mall_snapshot_id
foreignFields.description: Snapshot that this party visibility entry belongs to {@link shopping_mall_snapshots.id}.

plainFields.name: party_type
plainFields.description: Discriminator for what kind of party the stored party_id refers to (e.g., 'owner' for snapshot owner reference, 'admin' for administrative visibility).

plainFields.name: party_id
plainFields.description: Identifier of the party that can view the snapshot. The meaning depends on party_type.

plainFields.name: can_view
plainFields.description: Whether the party is allowed to view the snapshot.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Creation timestamp of this visibility relationship.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Last update timestamp of this visibility relationship.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Soft delete timestamp; when set, the visibility relationship is treated as removed.

models.name: shopping_mall_snapshot_payloads
models.description: Stores the optional payload content for a single {@link shopping_mall_snapshots.id} snapshot record. This table exists to keep snapshot content separate from snapshot metadata and to support flexible payload storage tied strictly 1:1 to a snapshot.

foreignFields.name: shopping_mall_snapshot_id
foreignFields.description: Belonged snapshot {@link shopping_mall_snapshots.id} that this payload content is attached to.

plainFields.name: payload
plainFields.description: Serialized snapshot payload content associated with the snapshot record.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Creation timestamp for this payload record.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Last update timestamp for this payload record.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Soft deletion timestamp for this payload record.

models.name: shopping_mall_categories
models.description:
Product category hierarchy and customer browsing visibility for the catalog.

Each category can optionally have a single parent category to enable one-level nesting. The visibility state controls whether customers can browse the category in listings and search. Products reference categories for organization, so categories are used as primary lookup points for filtering and storefront navigation.

This table supports soft deletion via deleted_at so categories can be hidden without breaking historical references from products and snapshots.

foreignFields.name: parent_category_id
foreignFields.description: Optional parent category enabling one-level nesting. When set, this category is a child of the parent category.

plainFields.name: name
plainFields.description: Human-readable category name shown to customers.

plainFields.name: description
plainFields.description: Short category description used to provide context in the storefront.

plainFields.name: slug
plainFields.description: URL-safe identifier for the category, used for stable links and routing.

plainFields.name: visibility
plainFields.description: Controls customer browsing visibility for this category (e.g., active vs hidden).

plainFields.name: display_order
plainFields.description: Ordering value used to sort categories within the same parent scope.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Record creation timestamp.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Record last update timestamp.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Soft delete timestamp. When set, the category is treated as removed/hidden.

models.name: shopping_mall_product_images
models.description:
Stores image entries that belong to a specific product for storefront display.

Each row represents one product image asset (e.g., a cover image or gallery image) associated with exactly one product. Images can be soft-deleted so the product can keep historical associations while hiding images from active storefront listings.

This table is a dependent asset of {@link shopping_mall_products}; its lifecycle is managed in the context of product creation and editing, and it typically does not require independent standalone CRUD operations beyond product management flows.

foreignFields.name: shopping_mall_product_id
foreignFields.description: Belonged product's {@link shopping_mall_products.id}.

plainFields.name: href
plainFields.description: Public URL/URI of the product image asset to be rendered on the storefront.

plainFields.name: alt_text
plainFields.description: Alternative text for the image for accessibility and improved storefront rendering.

plainFields.name: display_order
plainFields.description: Sort order among images of the same product; lower values are displayed earlier.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Creation timestamp.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Last update timestamp.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Soft delete timestamp; when set, the image is hidden from active storefront listings.

models.name: shopping_mall_products
models.description:
Seller-owned products that are organized under a category for storefront listing and search. Sellers create and update product information; the platform can soft-delete products to hide them from customer browsing while preserving historical references for related entities like product variants and snapshots.

This table stores only product-level attributes. Variant definitions, images, and immutable history snapshots are stored in separate tables handled by other components.

foreignFields.name: shopping_mall_seller_id
foreignFields.description: Belonged seller's {@link shopping_mall_members.id}.

foreignFields.name: shopping_mall_category_id
foreignFields.description: Belonged category's {@link shopping_mall_categories.id}.

plainFields.name: code
plainFields.description: Seller-scoped product code used for identification and internal/reference lookup. Must be unique within the same seller.

plainFields.name: name
plainFields.description: Public product name displayed to customers.

plainFields.name: description
plainFields.description: Product description shown on the product detail page.

plainFields.name: is_featured
plainFields.description: Whether this product is marked as featured for higher visibility in listings.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Record creation timestamp.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Record last update timestamp.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Soft delete timestamp. When set, the product is hidden from customer listings/search.

models.name: shopping_mall_product_snapshots
models.description: Immutable snapshot of a product's point-in-time state for audit history and dispute resolution. Each snapshot stores denormalized product attributes as they were at the time the snapshot was created, and it remains queryable even if the live product changes or is soft-deleted.

foreignFields.name: shopping_mall_product_id
foreignFields.description: Belonged product whose state is captured in this snapshot {@link shopping_mall_products.id}.

plainFields.name: snapshot_code
plainFields.description: Stable code or identifier of the product at the snapshot moment (denormalized for dispute resolution).

plainFields.name: snapshot_name
plainFields.description: Product display name at the snapshot moment (denormalized).

plainFields.name: snapshot_description
plainFields.description: Product description text at the snapshot moment (denormalized).

plainFields.name: snapshot_category_id
plainFields.description: Category reference captured at the snapshot moment for historical consistency; nullable when the product has no category at snapshot time.

plainFields.name: snapshot_seller_id
plainFields.description: Seller reference captured at the snapshot moment for historical consistency.

plainFields.name: display_price
plainFields.description: Optional denormalized price shown for the product at the snapshot moment; null when price is not applicable at snapshot time.

plainFields.name: is_listed
plainFields.description: Whether the product was considered listed/visible at the snapshot moment.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: When this snapshot record was created.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: When this snapshot record was last updated (typically only used for soft-delete metadata).

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Soft delete timestamp for this snapshot record.

models.name: shopping_mall_product_variants
models.description:
Product variant definitions that belong to a specific product ({@link shopping_mall_products}). Variants represent sellable unit-level choices (e.g., size/color) whose real availability is governed by immutable inventory history in {@link shopping_mall_inventory_records}. The variant can be soft-deleted (via {@link shopping_mall_product_variants.deleted_at}) to make it unavailable for listings and purchasing.

This table stores stable variant identity and basic sell-side fields (such as display name and base price). It does not store derived inventory counts or computed availability flags; those are determined from inventory records and/or application queries.

foreignFields.name: shopping_mall_product_id
foreignFields.description: Belonged product of this variant {@link shopping_mall_product_variants.shopping_mall_product_id}.

plainFields.name: code
plainFields.description: Human-/system-friendly unique code (SKU-like) identifying this variant within its product or channel.

plainFields.name: title
plainFields.description: Display title/name for the variant (e.g., "Red - Large").

plainFields.name: option_value
plainFields.description: The variant option value that differentiates this variant (e.g., "Red", "Large", or combined option representation).

plainFields.name: price
plainFields.description: Base price of this variant used when adding to cart and ordering (inventory-driven availability is handled separately).

plainFields.name: is_active
plainFields.description: Whether this variant is enabled for purchasing at the business level. When false, it should be treated as unavailable even if deleted_at is not set.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Creation timestamp.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Last update timestamp.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Soft-delete timestamp. When set, the variant is hidden/unavailable for listings and purchasing.

models.name: shopping_mall_product_variant_snapshots
models.description: Immutable point-in-time snapshot of a product variant for audit, dispute resolution, and historical review. Each record captures the variant’s state at the moment the snapshot is created, including its linkage to the current variant and all business-relevant attributes needed to reproduce the variant’s meaning without depending on the latest mutable variant row.

foreignFields.name: shopping_mall_product_variant_id
foreignFields.description: Belonged product variant snapshot refers to {@link shopping_mall_product_variants.id}.

plainFields.name: code
plainFields.description: Variant code/SKU used for identification at the time of snapshot creation.

plainFields.name: name
plainFields.description: Human-readable variant name/title at snapshot time.

plainFields.name: price
plainFields.description: Unit price of the variant at snapshot time.

plainFields.name: currency
plainFields.description: ISO currency code for {@link price} at snapshot time (e.g., KRW, USD).

plainFields.name: is_available
plainFields.description: Whether the variant was considered available/listable at snapshot time based on inventory and deletion/unavailability state.

plainFields.name: variant_status
plainFields.description: Business status of the variant at snapshot time for audit reconstruction.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Snapshot creation timestamp.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Last update timestamp for this snapshot record metadata.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Soft delete timestamp for the snapshot record, if removed from active audit lookup.

models.name: shopping_mall_inventory_records
models.description:
Immutable inventory history entries for a {@link shopping_mall_product_variants.id}.

Each record represents a point-in-time change or snapshot of variant stock maintained by the seller/inventory subsystem. The system should only append new records; historical rows are preserved for auditing and for computing the current stock/availability when required.

foreignFields.name: shopping_mall_product_variant_id
foreignFields.description: Belonged product variant {@link shopping_mall_product_variants.id} that this inventory record updates historically.

plainFields.name: stock_quantity
plainFields.description: Total stock quantity for the product variant at the time this inventory record was created.

plainFields.name: reserved_quantity
plainFields.description: Quantity reserved/locked for pending orders at the time this inventory record was created (so availability can be derived from stored values).

plainFields.name: available_quantity
plainFields.description: Quantity available for purchase immediately at the time this inventory record was created.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Record creation timestamp.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Record update timestamp (should typically not change after append-only insert).

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Soft-delete timestamp for administrative correction; historical integrity should be preserved according to system policies.

models.name: shopping_mall_wishlists
models.description:
Stores a customer's wishlist container, used to save wished products for later consideration.

Each wishlist belongs to exactly one member account and serves as the parent for wishlist items ({@link shopping_mall_wishlist_items}). The wishlist itself is a container entity; product references live in the wishlist item table.

foreignFields.name: shopping_mall_member_id
foreignFields.description: Owner member account for this wishlist ({@link shopping_mall_members.id}).

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Record creation timestamp.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Record last update timestamp.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Soft delete timestamp; when set, the wishlist is treated as deleted/hidden.

models.name: shopping_mall_wishlist_items
models.description:
Stores individual entries inside a customer's wishlist. Each wishlist item references exactly one {@link shopping_mall_wishlists.id} (the owning wishlist) and exactly one {@link shopping_mall_products.id} (the wished product) to preserve normalization and prevent duplicated product data.

A wishlist item can be soft-deleted to hide removed products while keeping historical records if needed. Duplicate entries for the same (wishlist, product) are prevented to maintain wishlist integrity.

foreignFields.name: shopping_mall_wishlist_id
foreignFields.description: Belonged wishlist's {@link shopping_mall_wishlists.id}.

foreignFields.name: shopping_mall_product_id
foreignFields.description: Belonged product's {@link shopping_mall_products.id}.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: When this wishlist item record was created.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: When this wishlist item record was last updated.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Soft delete timestamp for hiding a wishlist item without removing the row.

models.name: shopping_mall_carts
models.description: Customer-owned cart container used to assemble selected product variants and their quantities before checkout. It references the owning customer account and stores cart-level state such as whether the cart currently has inventory insufficiency warnings. Cart items hold variant quantities and line-level derived pricing, so the cart table itself does not store item lists as embedded/JSON data.

foreignFields.name: shopping_mall_member_id
foreignFields.description: Belonged customer's {@link shopping_mall_members.id}. Store cart ownership to ensure customers can only access their own cart.

plainFields.name: warning_inventory_insufficient
plainFields.description: Whether this cart currently contains items whose requested quantities exceed available inventory for one or more variants.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Creation timestamp of the cart container.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Last update timestamp of the cart container.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Soft delete timestamp. When set, the cart is treated as removed from active use.

models.name: shopping_mall_cart_items
models.description: Stores a single line item inside a customer's cart. Each row references exactly one purchased product variant, with the chosen quantity for that cart and the subtotal amount captured at the time the cart item was stored. This table is the atomic cart-entry unit for later checkout and inventory-warning computations.

foreignFields.name: shopping_mall_cart_id
foreignFields.description: Belonged cart {@link shopping_mall_carts.id}.

foreignFields.name: shopping_mall_product_variant_id
foreignFields.description: Referenced product variant {@link shopping_mall_product_variants.id} for this cart line.

plainFields.name: quantity
plainFields.description: Quantity of the referenced product variant in this cart item.

plainFields.name: subtotal_amount
plainFields.description: Subtotal amount for this cart item as captured when the item state was stored (derived from variant price and quantity).

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Creation time of the cart item.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Last update time of the cart item.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Soft-delete time of the cart item. When set, the item is treated as removed from the cart.

models.name: shopping_mall_orders
models.description:
Customer-owned order header created from a successful checkout/payment attempt.

This record represents the outcome of placing an order, including a locked shipping address snapshot captured at placement time. The order is grouped into per-seller shipments, while individual line items are stored in {@link shopping_mall_order_items} and fulfilled through {@link shopping_mall_shipments}. Soft-deletion is supported to hide orders without removing historical disputes.

foreignFields.name: shopping_customer_id
foreignFields.description: Belonged customer who owns this order. {@link shopping_mall_orders.shopping_customer_id} references {@link shopping_mall_members.id}.

foreignFields.name: shopping_payment_id
foreignFields.description: The payment attempt whose success led to the creation of this order. {@link shopping_mall_orders.shopping_payment_id} references {@link shopping_mall_payments.id}.

plainFields.name: order_code
plainFields.description: Human-readable unique code for the order, useful for support lookup and customer reference.

plainFields.name: ship_to_name
plainFields.description: Recipient name captured from the customer's address at order placement time.

plainFields.name: ship_to_phone
plainFields.description: Recipient phone captured from the customer's address at order placement time.

plainFields.name: ship_to_postal_code
plainFields.description: Destination postal code captured from the customer's address at order placement time.

plainFields.name: ship_to_region
plainFields.description: Destination region/province/state captured from the customer's address at order placement time.

plainFields.name: ship_to_city
plainFields.description: Destination city captured from the customer's address at order placement time.

plainFields.name: ship_to_street_address
plainFields.description: Street address (including building/house number) captured from the customer's address at order placement time.

plainFields.name: ship_to_detail_address
plainFields.description: Additional address detail (unit/apartment/etc.) captured from the customer's address at order placement time.

plainFields.name: shipping_instructions
plainFields.description: Optional delivery instructions captured at order placement time.

plainFields.name: placed_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the order was placed successfully after payment confirmation.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Record creation time.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Record last update time.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Soft delete timestamp. When set, the order is hidden from normal queries while remaining available for audit/dispute history.

models.name: shopping_mall_order_items
models.description:
Represents a single purchased line item within a customer order.

This table stores the purchased product variant at the time of checkout, captures the seller-facing snapshot context for dispute resolution, and tracks the line-item workflow status derived from fulfillment and post-purchase actions. Order items are the unit that can receive cancellation/refund requests and that are included in shipments grouped per seller.

foreignFields.name: shopping_mall_order_id
foreignFields.description: Belonged order {@link shopping_mall_orders.id}.

foreignFields.name: shopping_mall_product_variant_id
foreignFields.description: Purchased product variant {@link shopping_mall_product_variants.id}.

foreignFields.name: seller_snapshot_id
foreignFields.description: Seller snapshot context captured for this purchase for dispute resolution {@link shopping_mall_snapshots.id}.

foreignFields.name: shopping_mall_shipment_id
foreignFields.description: Shipment that includes this order item {@link shopping_mall_shipments.id}.

plainFields.name: seller_price_at_purchase
plainFields.description: Unit price (per purchased quantity) as captured at purchase time, used for fulfillment-related calculations and display consistency.

plainFields.name: quantity
plainFields.description: Purchased quantity for this line item.

plainFields.name: line_item_status
plainFields.description: Current workflow status for this order item line (e.g., created, shipped, delivered, cancellation_requested, refund_requested, cancelled, refunded). Stored as raw value to reflect business workflow progression.

plainFields.name: placed_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when this line item was locked/placed as part of the order placement flow.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Creation timestamp.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Last update timestamp.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Soft delete timestamp. When set, the order item is treated as removed from active views.

models.name: shopping_mall_payments
models.description:
Payment attempts associated with placing an order.

Each record represents one attempt to charge the customer for a specific order placement flow. The payment's status indicates whether the attempt succeeded or failed, which in turn determines whether the corresponding order can be considered created/valid in the fulfillment workflow.

This table is designed for auditing and dispute investigation by tracking provider and reference information for each attempt.

plainFields.name: amount
plainFields.description: Payment amount attempted for this order placement attempt.

plainFields.name: currency
plainFields.description: Currency code for the payment amount (e.g., KRW, USD).

plainFields.name: provider
plainFields.description: Payment service provider identifier used to process the payment attempt.

plainFields.name: provider_reference
plainFields.description: Provider-side reference/transaction identifier for the payment attempt.

plainFields.name: status
plainFields.description: Current payment attempt status (e.g., pending, succeeded, failed).

plainFields.name: paid_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the payment provider confirmed the payment as successful.

plainFields.name: error_code
plainFields.description: Provider or application error code when payment fails.

plainFields.name: error_message
plainFields.description: Provider or application error message when payment fails.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: When this payment attempt record was created.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: When this payment attempt record was last updated.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Soft delete timestamp. Null when the record is active.

models.name: shopping_mall_shipments
models.description:
Groups purchased order items for fulfillment within a single order on a per-seller basis.

Each shipment record represents one seller-specific fulfillment batch inside an order (i.e., all order items in the same order that share the same seller purchase context are grouped together). Shipment lifecycle progression (e.g., shipped/delivered) is updated through the related shipment confirmation flow handled by {@link shopping_mall_shipment_confirmations}.

This table stores the core shipment identity, its parent order linkage, the seller purchase context used for grouping, and the shipment status state visible to the customer and seller.

foreignFields.name: shopping_mall_order_id
foreignFields.description: Belonged order's {@link shopping_mall_orders.id}. Shipment groups order items within that order.

plainFields.name: seller_snapshot_id
plainFields.description: Seller snapshot identifier that defines the seller-specific purchase context used to group items inside the order.

plainFields.name: status
plainFields.description: Current shipment status as driven by the shipment confirmation process (e.g., pending, shipped, delivered, cancelled).

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Record creation timestamp.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Record last update timestamp.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Soft delete timestamp. When set, the shipment is treated as removed from active fulfillment views.

models.name: shopping_mall_shipment_confirmations
models.description: Seller confirmation data for a shipment that is used to transition included order items to shipped/delivered states. This table is a dedicated, immutable-style record associated with exactly one shipment to preserve seller-provided confirmation details for dispute resolution and audit.

foreignFields.name: shopping_mall_shipment_id
foreignFields.description: Belonged shipment that this seller confirmation is confirming for fulfillment transitions, referencing {@link shopping_mall_shipments.id}.

plainFields.name: confirmation_type
plainFields.description: Type of confirmation the seller is submitting for the shipment (e.g., shipped vs delivered).

plainFields.name: confirmed_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the seller confirmation is considered valid for status transitions.

plainFields.name: tracking_url
plainFields.description: Optional tracking page URL provided by the seller for the shipment.

plainFields.name: tracking_number
plainFields.description: Optional carrier tracking number provided by the seller for the shipment.

plainFields.name: carrier_name
plainFields.description: Optional carrier/service name used for this shipment.

plainFields.name: note
plainFields.description: Optional seller note included with the confirmation (visible for dispute resolution).

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Record creation time.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Record last update time.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Soft delete timestamp. When set, this confirmation record is treated as removed without hard deletion.

models.name: shopping_mall_cancellation_requests
models.description: Customer-initiated cancellation requests for a specific order item. Each request is attached to an OrderItem and enters a seller-approval workflow; the seller's response (approved/rejected) determines the subsequent status handling for the order item. This table also supports historical dispute resolution because the request retains the customer reason and the seller response outcome captured at the time of decision.

foreignFields.name: shopping_mall_order_item_id
foreignFields.description: Belonged order item that this cancellation request is targeting: {@link shopping_mall_order_items.id}.

plainFields.name: reason
plainFields.description: Customer-provided reason for requesting cancellation of the order item.

plainFields.name: requested_at
plainFields.description: When the cancellation request was created/placed by the customer (business event time).

plainFields.name: status
plainFields.description: Seller-approval workflow status of this cancellation request (e.g., pending seller approval, approved, rejected).

plainFields.name: seller_decisioned_at
plainFields.description: When the seller made the approval/rejection decision for this request. Null until the seller responds.

plainFields.name: seller_response_reason
plainFields.description: Optional explanation provided by the seller when rejecting (or optionally explaining) the cancellation request.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Creation time of the cancellation request record.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Last update time of the cancellation request record.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Soft delete timestamp. When set, the request is treated as deleted while keeping historical traceability.

models.name: shopping_mall_refund_requests
models.description: Represents a customer-initiated refund request for a specific purchased order item that requires seller approval. The record stores the refund request workflow state, customer-provided reason details, and seller approval decision metadata used to drive OrderItem status transitions.

foreignFields.name: shopping_mall_order_item_id
foreignFields.description: Belonged order item for which this refund request is raised. {@link shopping_mall_order_items.id}

plainFields.name: customer_reason
plainFields.description: Customer-provided reason/details for requesting a refund for the referenced order item.

plainFields.name: status
plainFields.description: Workflow status of the refund request (e.g., pending seller approval, approved, rejected).

plainFields.name: seller_comment
plainFields.description: Optional seller note provided when approving or rejecting the refund request.

plainFields.name: decisioned_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the seller made the refund decision; set when the status transitions out of the pending state.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Creation timestamp of the refund request record.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Last update timestamp of the refund request record.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Soft delete timestamp for removing refund requests from active views while retaining history.

models.name: shopping_mall_reviews
models.description:
Customer reviews tied to a specific purchase context (OrderItem) and a reviewed product.

This table stores the current review content (rating and optional text) created by a customer for an order item purchase context. It supports soft deletion via {@link shopping_mall_reviews.deleted_at} while snapshot linkage and historical indexing are handled by the snapshot-related tables.

Relationships:
- Each review belongs to exactly one {@link shopping_mall_order_items} record (1:1 enforced by a unique constraint on shopping_mall_order_item_id).
- Each review belongs to one {@link shopping_mall_products} record.
- Each review is authored by one {@link shopping_mall_customers} record (a customer can write many reviews).

foreignFields.name: shopping_mall_order_item_id
foreignFields.description: Belonged purchase context {@link shopping_mall_order_items.id}.

foreignFields.name: shopping_mall_product_id
foreignFields.description: Belonged reviewed product {@link shopping_mall_products.id}.

foreignFields.name: shopping_mall_customer_id
foreignFields.description: Authoring customer {@link shopping_mall_members.id}.

plainFields.name: rating
plainFields.description: Star rating given by the customer for the purchased product, within the allowed rating range defined by the application.

plainFields.name: body
plainFields.description: Optional textual content of the review provided by the customer.

plainFields.name: is_public
plainFields.description: Whether this review is publicly visible to other customers (independent of soft deletion).

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Record creation timestamp.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Record last update timestamp.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Soft delete timestamp; when set, the review is treated as deleted/hidden.

models.name: shopping_mall_review_snapshots_indices
models.description: Immutable snapshot index entries for customer reviews, used to link each review state change (create/edit/delete) to the central snapshot mechanism and to preserve ordering metadata for dispute resolution. Each row represents one snapshot event for a specific review and stores the ordering position so history can be reconstructed deterministically.

plainFields.name: shopping_mall_snapshot_id
plainFields.description: Reference to the central {@link shopping_mall_snapshots.id} record that stores the snapshot metadata for this review state change.

plainFields.name: review_id
plainFields.description: Reference to the associated current review business record that this snapshot index entry belongs to.

plainFields.name: action_type
plainFields.description: Indicates what happened to the review for this snapshot index entry (e.g., created, updated, deleted).

plainFields.name: snapshot_sequence
plainFields.description: Monotonically increasing sequence number for this review's snapshot events, used to preserve ordering in history views.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: When this snapshot index entry was created.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: When this snapshot index entry was last updated (typically set at creation and not changed).

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Soft delete marker for this snapshot index entry; normally null for immutable history.

models.name: shopping_mall_addresses
models.description: Stores customer-owned shipping address book entries used at checkout. Each address record captures the recipient details and full destination fields and can be marked as the customer's default address. Addresses are soft-deletable to keep historical references while still maintaining an address book for active updates.

foreignFields.name: shopping_mall_customer_id
foreignFields.description: Belonged customer's {@link shopping_mall_members.id}.

plainFields.name: recipient_name
plainFields.description: Recipient full name for the shipping address.

plainFields.name: phone_number
plainFields.description: Recipient phone number for delivery contact.

plainFields.name: postal_code
plainFields.description: Postal/ZIP code for the destination address.

plainFields.name: country
plainFields.description: Destination country name or ISO-like country representation.

plainFields.name: city
plainFields.description: Destination city/region.

plainFields.name: street_line1
plainFields.description: Primary street address line (e.g., street, building name).

plainFields.name: street_line2
plainFields.description: Secondary address line (e.g., apartment/suite), if any.

plainFields.name: is_default
plainFields.description: Whether this address is the customer's default shipping address.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Record creation timestamp.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Record last update timestamp.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Soft delete timestamp. When set, the address is treated as removed from the address book.

models.name: shopping_mall_address_snapshots
models.description:
Point-in-time immutable snapshots of a customer's address record for dispute resolution and historical reference.

When a customer updates an address, or when address data must be locked for an operation (e.g., capturing the exact recipient/destination at a business moment), the system records the relevant address fields into this snapshot table. This table preserves customer-provided values as they were at snapshot creation time, without being affected by later edits or soft deletion of the original address.

{@link shopping_mall_addresses} is the source address record; this snapshot denormalizes its fields so disputes can be handled using the original data.

foreignFields.name: shopping_mall_address_id
foreignFields.description: Belonged address record that this snapshot captures {@link shopping_mall_addresses.id}.

plainFields.name: recipient_name
plainFields.description: Recipient name captured at snapshot creation time.

plainFields.name: recipient_phone
plainFields.description: Recipient phone number captured at snapshot creation time.

plainFields.name: postal_code
plainFields.description: Postal/ZIP code for the delivery destination captured at snapshot creation time.

plainFields.name: region_line1
plainFields.description: Top-level region (e.g., state/province/city district) captured at snapshot creation time.

plainFields.name: region_line2
plainFields.description: Secondary region/address line captured at snapshot creation time (e.g., neighborhood/area).

plainFields.name: street_address_line1
plainFields.description: Primary street/building address line captured at snapshot creation time.

plainFields.name: street_address_line2
plainFields.description: Detailed address line captured at snapshot creation time (e.g., building name, unit/room details).

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Snapshot creation timestamp.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Last update timestamp for this snapshot record (typically unchanged after creation).

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Soft delete timestamp for administrative cleanup; snapshot history should remain available in normal operations.
